column1: # Hinglish (Hindi in Latin letters) and English abuse. Hand-curated for Stream Sarthi (no third-party list copied).
# category: abuse. Terms are written in lexicon form (lowercase, leet undone); the loader normalises them too.
# Repeated letters are squeezed at match time, so list one spelling (chutiya also matches chutiyaaa).
# Severity 3 = slur / severe sexual-family abuse, 2 = abusive, 1 = mild or ambiguous (goes to the LLM stage).
